description:
Feather Task Manager is a small, lightweight task manager for Windows 10 and 11. It is written in native Rust on the Win32 API, with no Electron, no WebView and no extra runtime. The app is a single executable of about 1.9 MB and used about 25 MB of memory on the developer's PC. Data collection pauses while the window is minimized, and animations run only while something is moving.

App groups put each program's processes under one collapsible row with counts and totals. You can switch to a list or tree view, spot load with the heatmap, and find anything with the command palette (Ctrl+K). End a task or a whole process tree with confirmation, change priority or turn on efficiency mode. Processes critical to Windows are protected.

The Performance page shows CPU base speed, caches and virtualization; memory speed, used slots and form factor; disk model, bus and capacity; network adapter model and link speed; and GPU model, memory, driver, temperature, fan and power. Performance history keeps recording while you visit other pages.

Nuclear Zombie trims working sets, clears the standby cache or flushes modified pages (administrator), and finds "zombie" processes that have exited but are still held open by another program. It shows measured before/after numbers. Windows already reuses cached memory automatically, so this mainly helps after a big spike or when you are looking for a leaking program.

Optional: from Settings, you can let Ctrl+Shift+Esc open Feather, and restore Windows Task Manager at any time. The uninstaller restores it automatically. You can also have the installed Feather start as administrator every time, through the normal Windows UAC prompt.

English and Korean; light, dark or system theme. Open source (MIT), signed by HARDT. No telemetry, no ads, no account, no network connections.

Limitations: CPU temperature is not shown, because Windows has no safe user-mode source for it. Per-process network usage is measured only when Feather runs as administrator. Installation requires administrator permission.

Feather Task Manager is an independent app and is not affiliated with Microsoft.
shortDescription: A small, lightweight task manager for Windows 10 and 11, built with native Rust and Win32. App groups, per-process GPU, detailed hardware information and honest memory tools. No telemetry, no ads, no account.
productFeatures: Native Rust + Win32: no Electron, WebView or extra runtime. The app is a single executable of about 1.9 MB.
Light on resources: about 25 MB of memory on the developer's PC. Collection pauses while the window is minimized.
App groups: each program's processes in one collapsible row with process counts and summed usage.
List and tree views, a usage heatmap and a command palette (Ctrl+K).
End task or end process tree, always with confirmation. Processes critical to Windows are protected.
Change priority and turn on efficiency mode per process.
Per-process GPU usage, using Windows Task Manager's busiest-engine rule.
Per-process network usage through ETW when Feather runs as administrator. Settings can start it as administrator every time.
CPU details: base speed, caches, virtualization and logical processors.
Memory details: speed in MT/s, used slots (for example 2 of 4) and form factor.
Disk model, NVMe/SATA/USB bus, capacity and system disk; network adapter model and link speed.
GPU model, dedicated and shared memory, driver, temperature, fan RPM and power as a percentage of the limit.
Nuclear Zombie: trim working sets, clear the standby cache or flush modified pages (administrator), with measured before/after numbers.
Find zombie processes that have exited but are still held open by another program. The scan is read-only; ending a holder always asks first.
Turn startup apps on or off, and start, stop or restart services.
Optional, off by default: let Ctrl+Shift+Esc open Feather. You can restore Windows Task Manager from Settings at any time.
Custom-drawn interface with one 44 px title bar, Windows 11 Snap Layouts, pixel-smooth scrolling and overlay scrollbars.
English and Korean; light, dark or system theme; screen reader (MSAA) support for tables.
No telemetry, no ads, no account and no network connections. Open source under the MIT license.
Signed by HARDT with Azure Artifact Signing and timestamped. SHA-256 checksums are published with each release.

requirements.minimumHardware: Windows 10 version 1607 or later, or Windows 11, 64-bit (x64). Installation requires administrator permission (UAC).
